_about: The default title rules for an engineering role (SEARCH_RULES, default apply/search-rules.json; searches.py rules --write copies this file there), applied by collect_postings.py before any text is read. Each value is a regular expression, case-insensitive; a key left out does not count. forms_out: another language's title form; low: a level too low; no: a role to drop; soft_no: dropped unless the title also holds a need word (example: 'Customer Success Manager' goes, 'Software Engineer, Customer Platform' stays); need: an engineering word (with it, a row that searches by its terms needs none of them in the title). No level word is asked (keys level and senior, one of them needed; senior_need and senior_no): seen 23 Nov 2026, plain 'Java Developer' and 'Backend Engineer' titles held most high fits, and a level-word rule kept 5 of 26. Adapt need, no, soft_no and low to the person's roles, and forms_out to the languages they read, with their yes.
